source.title: Everyday Rye Sourdough
source.text:
A 70% hydration loaf with a third rye. Makes one 900g loaf.

Ingredients
350 g strong white bread flour
150 g wholegrain rye flour
350 ml water at 30C
100 g active sourdough starter
10 g fine sea salt

Method
1. Mix the flours and water and leave to autolyse for 45 minutes.
2. Add the starter and salt and work them through until fully incorporated.
3. Four sets of stretch and folds, 30 minutes apart.
4. Bulk for 4 hours at room temperature, then shape and cold retard overnight.
5. Bake at 250C in a covered pot for 20 minutes, then uncovered at 220C for 25.
